entities.summary: Leonard Toney Weaver III is an American former professional football player who was a fullback in the National Football League (NFL). He played college football for the Carson-Newman Eagles. He was signed by the Seattle Seahawks as an undrafted free agent in 2005, and has also played for the Philadelphia Eagles. He retired from the NFL in 2013.
